newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour MP Patchett dies - BBC report.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour MP Patchett dies - BBC report.

text.p: The opposition Labour member of parliament Terry Patchett has died, the BBC reported on Friday.
Patchett represented the northern English seat of Barnsley East, where he had a majority of 24,777.
A spokeswoman for Patchett's office confirmed his death, saying he died on Friday morning. He had been suffering from cancer for several years.
